description: issue #851: `set_shape "arrow"` - `"arrow"` is one of the four portable shape words that `spec/rendering.md` now requires every implementation to support (MUST, raised from SHOULD), so it is accepted, updates `turtle.shape` from the default `"turtle"`, and emits `shape-change` ({from: "turtle", to: "arrow"}) with no diagnostic. It is the word the runnable sprite example in `spec/turtles-and-sprites.md` uses, and it is asserted here in the Turtle & Rendering profile that OWNS `set_shape` - `sprites/shape-tell-two-turtles` already exercised it, but only under Sprites, so an implementation claiming just the minimal Core + Turtle & Rendering path had nothing pinning it.
